a.lede: Nvidia has told cloud providers who use its data center products that they must sell less than half of their services to Chinese companies as part of a new policy that will further impact China's ability to keep up with the global AI surge.
a.title: Nvidia tells data center operators to limit business from Chinese customers with new global restrictions, report claims

b.lede: Just 1% of chips promised to major Chinese companies to power their AI ambitions will be delivered, according to reports.
b.title: Nvidia can only fulfill 1% of China’s massive $70 billion GPU order for AI chips, report claims — supply constraints choke export-friendly RTX Pro 5500 deliveries despite huge demand
